description: Reusable review area, with information, progress and decision actions.

howToUse: Use it for a queue of items reviewed one by one: documents to approve, submissions to check, claims to analyse.
Pass the `items`; the list stays on one side and the item in `activeId` opens in the panel. Change it in `onActiveChange`.
Your application decides and saves the outcome of each item.
alternatives: A decision on a single item: DecisionActions.
A list to browse, with no decision: Table.

keyboard.action: Moves through the list items and the panel actions.
Opens the item in focus, or runs the action.

props.description: Accessible name and title of the work list.

props.description: Selects another item without changing page.
